expectedAnswers.q10: Across configured Aave markets, balance-sheet exposure is $37,414,820.15 supplied against $4,068,892.66 borrowed, leaving $33,345,927.49 net; the resulting 10.88% is a portfolio debt-to-supply ratio, not an LTV. Exact leverage-to-liquidation or safety margin cannot be assessed without reserve thresholds and account health-factor data.
